description: Cross read (11-11 11:35, the coordinator): does the probit error tree's ply-1-field gain survive against a flat probit trained in a ply-2 field? probit-confirm-p2 (ply-2 field) read cold: T-P-Ne minus F-P 18 ±21 at ply 2, -17 at ply 1, -49 at ply 3, where G2's ply-1-field trees were 118 / 77 over their F-P. One field of both runs' finals: error-routing-p1 (ply-1 field, v314) and probit-confirm-p2 (ply-2 field, v241), F-P x2 and T-P-Ne x2 each, at plies 1-3, T 0.02, 75 round-robins, hybrid13 (the reads' settings). Tags: fp1/ne1 = trained in the ply-1 field, fp2/ne2 = in the ply-2 field. Contrasts: arm_btg.py TOUR fp2 (and fp1).
